chunks: And Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام said:
If, in the hadd punishment, there is 'perhaps' or 'it may be,' then the hadd punishment is suspended.

key_terms.الْحَدِّ: the prescribed legal punishment in Islamic law
key_terms.عَسَى: an expression indicating that something may be the case
key_terms.لَعَلَّ: an expression indicating possibility or uncertainty

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali عليه السلام say about applying hadd punishments when there is doubt?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal principle that prescribed punishments are not to be carried out when uncertainty or doubt is present. It reflects the importance of caution, certainty, and justice in the application of penal rulings.
